extDescription.message: On-time, private subtitles and translation for YouTube, transcribed on your own computer with whisper.cpp.

serverUrlHint.message: You can ignore this while the option below is on. It is only for people who run their own whisper-server: its address on this computer (127.0.0.1 or localhost).

autoStart.message: Start whisper-server automatically if it is not running (needs titl install)

modeLookahead.message: Lookahead — subtitles on time (opens a hidden muted tab)

modeLive.message: Live — transcribe what is playing (subtitles a few seconds late)

modeHint.message: Lookahead listens a little ahead of you in a hidden, muted tab, so each line appears right on time. Live listens to what you hear, so lines come a few seconds late. Live streams always use live mode.

skipAds.message: Click "Skip ad" in the hidden lookahead tab when YouTube offers it

translationHint.message: Runs on this device with Chrome's built-in translator. Serbian is translated as Croatian, which Chrome supports.

showOriginal.message: Show the original above the translation

blurTranslation.message: Blur the translation until you reveal it: press <kbd>V</kbd> or click the line

footerFree.message: Titl is free and open source.

savedApplied.message: Saved and applied to the running subtitles.

pathNotFound.message: Server is up, but this path returns 404

chooseTarget.message: Choose a language to translate to first

translatorUnavailableHere.message: Translator is not available here; it will download on your first click in a YouTube tab

cannotTranslatePair.message: Chrome can't translate $1 → $2 on this device

helperMissing.message: The Titl helper isn't installed on this computer.

cannotTranslateDevice.message: ⚠ Chrome can't translate $1 → $2 on this device

clickToDownload.message: Click the video once to download the translation model

translationStalled.message: ⚠ Chrome downloaded the language pack but didn't finish installing it. Restart Chrome and try again.

translatorSettingUp.message: Chrome is still setting up its translator. The first time, this can take a couple of minutes. Try again in a minute.

helperUpdated.message: Helper updated to $1. It's used from the next Start.

llmModel.message: Model name (optional for llama-server, e.g. gemma3:4b for Ollama)

llmHint.message: Any OpenAI-compatible server on this computer: llama-server (llama-server -hf ggml-org/gemma-3-4b-it-GGUF --port 8081, about 2.5 GB), Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1) or LM Studio (http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1). Must be on 127.0.0.1 or localhost.

debugHint.message: Include this when you report a problem. It shows file paths on this computer, which may contain your user name.

autoStartHint.message: Recommended. Titl starts the speech recognizer on this computer when you turn subtitles on. Turn it off only if you run whisper-server yourself.

skipAdsHint.message: Lookahead mode only. Skips ads in the hidden tab so subtitles are ready sooner. Ads you watch are not touched.

showEarlyHint.message: Lookahead mode only. Shows each line a moment before it is spoken, so you have time to read it. Raise it if lines feel late.

minLeadHint.message: Lookahead mode only. If subtitles fall behind, the video pauses briefly until they catch up. 0 means never pause.

llmUrlHint.message: Where the language model program on this computer can be reached.

llmModelHint.message: Which model that program should use. Leave it empty if it runs only one.

liveWindowHint.message: Live mode only. How many seconds of sound Titl listens to at a time. Longer is more accurate but a little later.

liveStepHint.message: Live mode only. How often the subtitles update. Smaller updates more often but works the computer harder.

maxWindowHint.message: The longest stretch of sound handled at once. If live subtitles fall further behind, Titl skips ahead to catch up.

lagThresholdHint.message: Live mode only. Titl tells you when the subtitles are this many seconds behind what you hear.
